verdict.rationale: Any public website, including a government tax agency's, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such resource: the front door returns an Akamai 403 even at robots.txt, and the application host returns the same 403 to keyless agents. Nothing in the pack indicates an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation exists, so there is no capability to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
